name: Apple 应用开发
description: 统一 iOS / macOS 的 SwiftUI、构建调试、性能与分发工作流，通过独立 XcodeBuildMCP 接入。

skills.name: cotree.apple-development.build
skills.description: 发现、构建与运行 iOS / macOS Xcode 和 SwiftPM 工程。

skills.name: cotree.apple-development.test
skills.description: 运行并诊断 Apple 单元、集成与 UI 测试。

skills.name: cotree.apple-development.swiftui
skills.description: 实现 iOS 与 macOS SwiftUI 导航、状态、场景和控件。

skills.name: cotree.apple-development.refactor
skills.description: 重构 SwiftUI View 与场景，保留数据流和可观察行为。

skills.name: cotree.apple-development.glass
skills.description: 按平台 SDK 实现和评估 SwiftUI Liquid Glass。

skills.name: cotree.apple-development.windows

skills.name: cotree.apple-development.appkit
skills.description: 通过窄边界连接 SwiftUI 与 AppKit。

skills.name: cotree.apple-development.intents
skills.description: 把 Apple 应用动作和实体暴露给 App Intents 系统入口。

skills.name: cotree.apple-development.performance
skills.description: 分析 SwiftUI 性能和 iOS Simulator ETTrace。

skills.name: cotree.apple-development.memory
skills.description: 收集和解释 Apple leaks / memgraph 的内存证据。

skills.name: cotree.apple-development.preview
skills.description: 预览 SwiftUI 与 iOS Simulator，并验证真实渲染。

skills.name: cotree.apple-development.telemetry
skills.description: 添加和核对 macOS Logger 运行时事件。

skills.name: cotree.apple-development.distribute
